messages:
michael: Heads-up — found a reproducible billing delta. Streaming session that hit truncation + client retry shows ~2x confirmed tokens in the ledger. See trace txn-2026-04-12-99a3 in logs. :eyeglasses:

jess: paste the trace id and a brief timeline? curious if this is the retry path or an extra toolcall being counted.

michael: trace_id=txn-2026-04-12-99a3
billing-bot: provisional_charge emitted: session=txn-2026-04-12-99a3 tokens=236 state=provisional

michael: Sequence: client opens stream, server returns a partial chunk and truncates due to max_tokens. Client reconnects/resumes. Router falls back to a toolcall route to finish the prefix. Toolcall returns and stream resumes. Ledger ends up showing both the provisional prefix tokens AND the toolcall tokens as confirmed. Looks like provisional entries weren't revoked when fallback succeeded.

tara: That matches a known gap: we only auto-cancel provisional on clean EOF. Truncation triggers early EOF and the resume flow doesn't always revoke provisional entries. State-machine gap.

sam: Do we see two different attribution keys? e.g. prefix_key=pf_... and toolcall_key=tc_...?

michael: yes: prefix_key=pf_99a3, toolcall_key=tc_99a3. Both marked confirmed after resume.

jess: Short-term mitigations: 1) Console UX: show provisional vs confirmed badges in timeline so ops can tell pending items. 2) Server: when resume chooses toolcall fallback, explicitly revoke matching provisionals.

tara: For safety I'd prefer an explicit provenance link rather than blind revocation: when the fallback toolcall succeeds, emit confirm with "supersedes: [prefix_key]" so ledger can dedupe deterministically. Minimizes surface area.

sam: Ledger API currently is POST /ledger/confirm {session_id,tokens,tags}. We can add optional supersedes array param. Backwards compatible.

michael: Example confirm call we could emit from router: ```POST /ledger/confirm {"session_id":"txn-2026-04-12-99a3","tokens":120,"tags":["stream","toolcall"],"supersedes":["pf_99a3"]}```

jess: Also add a small console filter to toggle provisional/confirmed. Ops will love the quick visibility.

tara: Telemetry: do we currently record resume_reason? If not, add resume_reason in route_event (values: resume, client_reconnect, fallback_toolcall) so we can query how frequent resume-via-toolcall is.

michael: Router emits route_event but no detailed resume_reason. Cheap change to add reason field and attach provenance keys.

sam: I'll add unit tests for ledger.confirm with supersedes to cover: (a) supersedes found -> consumed, confirmed only once; (b) supersedes missing -> behave as before. Also add e2e staging replay using the txn-2026-04-12-99a3 sequence.

jess: Plan summary: 1) sam: PR to add supersedes param + tests. 2) router: include resume_reason and pass supersedes when fallback toolcall used. 3) console: provisional/confirmed filter and timeline badge. 4) staging replay validation.

michael: Severity is low but noisy for support. Can we aim for a quick patch early next week?

sam: I'll schedule a 1-day PR Monday, staging test Tuesday.

tara: I'll write a short docs blurb about the ledger supersedes param and console filter so support can explain the symptom to customers.

jess: Follow-up action: if after staging we still see >1% resumed streams double-counting over a rolling week, we escalate to a hotfix that can be rolled out quickly. :thumbsup:

michael: tagging @support to FYI so they don't open duplicate tickets.

support: noted, will add a pre-canned response referencing provisional-filter and INV-2026-44.

billing-bot: created investigation ticket INV-2026-44 for txn-2026-04-12-99a3

implementation notes: sam: ledger.confirm change is additive. router change touches provenance propagation only. console change is UI toggle + highlight, no billing model changes. telemetry: emit route_event(reason) and include keys array. testing: synthetic replay should cover truncated-chunk -> client-reconnect -> router-fallback -> toolcall success -> resumed-stream.

open questions: tara: Do we need a GC window before supersedes are allowed? e.g. only allow supersedes within 5 minutes of provisional to avoid accidental dedupe across sessions. sam: let's enforce a 10-minute TTL on provisional entries and only accept supersedes within TTL. jess: add console flag to surface old provisionals beyond TTL.

michael: OK. next steps recorded in INV-2026-44. thanks all.
